role: Pydantic BaseSettings for perception pipeline configuration with environment variable loading
detail: Top-level PerceptionConfig (BaseSettings) loads from environment vars (COBEING_PERCEPTION_ prefix) and .env file using nested delimiter __. Seven subsection models: CameraConfig (device index, resolution 1280x720, fps 15, buffer_size 1 for latency); DetectionConfig (YOLO model yolov8n-seg.pt, confidence_threshold 0.25, nms_threshold 0.45); TrackingConfig (iou_threshold 0.3, max_lost_frames 15, min_confirm_frames 3); FaceDetectionConfig (confidence_threshold 0.5, model_selection 0 for short-range); PersistenceCheckConfig (similarity_threshold 0.7, spatial_tolerance 0.15, recency_window_hours 24.0, surprise_threshold 0.3, match_threshold 0.75, ambiguity_threshold 0.45 for Layer 2->3 re-identification matching); ValidationConfig (enabled True, min_area_fraction 0.001, min_confidence 0.30, embedding_norm_min 0.1, embedding_norm_max 100.0, aspect ratio bounds 0.1-10.0 for quality gate); VlmConfig (enabled True, moondream2 model, float32 dtype, auto device selection). All subsections use Pydantic Field validators with ge/le/gt bounds. Environment vars override defaults. Flat config hierarchy: root reads env, subsections are plain BaseModel. No network/DB/graph writes.
gotchas: No stubs or TODOs. All thresholds are reasonable defaults. Embedding norm max 100.0 is permissive; embedding_norm_min 0.1 flags zero-vectors from failed ONNX. Spatial_tolerance 0.15 means 15% of frame dimension—could miss tracked objects on frame edges. Persistence match_threshold 0.75 must be >= ambiguity_threshold 0.45, validated via Pydantic. VLM default prompt is hardcoded 80-char string optimized for describing people. Camera buffer_size=1 discards older frames for low latency but may skip frames under heavy load. No validation that match_threshold >= ambiguity_threshold at schema level (assumed enforced upstream).
